2026_05_MIN_NO.headline: Flores’ pressure tests Shough as Vikings search for more offensive touchdowns
2026_05_MIN_NO.paragraph1: Minnesota reaches New Orleans unbeaten largely because Brian Flores’ defense has limited scoring opportunities, even while the Vikings’ own offense has struggled to finish drives with touchdowns. Tyler Shough must identify pressure quickly and find safe throws before Minnesota’s blitz packages create negative plays. New Orleans is trying to recover from a heavy defeat to Atlanta, and its offense needs more productive early downs to keep the defense rested. Minnesota’s receiving group has injury concerns, making Aaron Jones and short passing important for Kyler Murray. Red-zone execution could decide the game.
2026_05_MIN_NO.model_rationale: Minnesota can pressure Shough into difficult decisions, but must convert defensive stops into touchdowns. New Orleans needs efficient early-down gains and improved protection to sustain possessions.
